summary: A committee officer reminds members that their vote alone cannot change appointment law.
realLife: Foreman cited a party resolution calling for Senate approval of the governor’s state Supreme Court appointments and pointed out that the party vote had not enacted a law.
inGame: needs: an adopted party resolution, its requested legal change and the legislative record.

turns.what: The officer gives members the bill’s designation.
turns.pulledBy: A legislator introduces a bill addressing the resolution.
turns.writesBack: The committee can follow the proposal through the legislature.

turns.what: The secretary records the resolution as the party’s request.
turns.pulledBy: No matching bill has been filed.
turns.writesBack: The appointment continues under the existing rule.
